p: from the evil to come: From the plague that is at hand, and also because God will punish the wicked.
He shall enter into peace: The soul of the righteous will be in joy, and their body will rest in the grave to the time of the resurrection, because they walked before the Lord.

sons of the sorceress: He threatens the wicked hypocrites, who under the pretence of the name of God's people, derided God's word and his promises: boasting openly that they were the children of Abraham, but because they were not faithful and obedient as Abraham was, he calls them bastards and the children of sorcerers, who forsook God, and fled to wicked means for comfort.
children in the valleys under the: Read Le 18:21, 2Ki 23:10.
of the stream is thy portion: Meaning every place was polluted with their idolatry: or every fair stone they found they made into an idol.
these: In the sacrifices which you offering before these idols thought you served God.
bed: That is, your altars in an open place, like an impudent harlot, that cares not for the sight of her husband.

doors also and the door posts: Instead of setting up the word of God in the open places on the posts and doors to have it in remembrance, De 6:9,27:1 you have set up signs and marks of your idolatry in every place.
enlarged thy bed: That is, increased your idolatry more and more.

to the king with ointment: You sought the favour of the Assyrians by gifts and presents to help you against the Egyptians and when they failed you sought the Babylonians, and more and more tormented yourself.
There is no hope: Although you saw all your labours to be in vain, yet would you never acknowledge your fault and leave off.
hast found the life of thy: He derides their unprofitable diligence, who thought to have made all sure, and yet were deceived.
lied: Broken promises with me.
old: Meaning, that the wicked abuse God's leniency, and grow to further wickedness.
and thy works: That is, your naughtiness, idolatry and impiety which the wicked call God's service: thus he derides their obstinacy.
shall carry them all away: Meaning, the Assyrians and others, whose help they looked for.
And shall say: God will say to Darius and Cyrus.
for the spirit should fail before: I will not use my power against frail man, whose life is but a blast.
iniquity of his covetousness I was: That is, for the vices and faults of the people, which is here meant by covetousness.
heal him: Though they were obstinate, yet I did not withdraw my mercy from them.
fruit of the lips: That is, I frame the speech and words of my messengers who will bring peace.
far off: As well to him that is in captivity as to him that remains at home.
cannot rest: Their evil conscience always torments them and therefore they can never have rest, Isa 48:22.
